summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO/IEC 20000 Lead Auditor exam with practical SMS audit training based on ISO/IEC 20000-1.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who audit, manage, or support service management systems and need to evaluate conformity with ISO/IEC 20000-1.
prerequisites: PECB states that you need a fundamental understanding of ISO/IEC 20000-1 requirements and comprehensive knowledge of audit principles to participate in this training course.
